description:
Who are we and why should you join us? 
 BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us and make mental healthcare more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. 
 As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand.  
 At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.  
 What are we looking for? 
 We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates. 
 You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision. 
 What will you do? 
 
 You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement. 
 You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code. 
 You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners. 
 You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs. 
 You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems. 
 You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas. 
 You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms. 
 You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code. 
 You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments. 
 You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience. 
 You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment. 
 You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks. 
 You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision. 
 
 We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software. 
 
 Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis 
 Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS 
 Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

description:
About Fieldguide 
 Fieldguide is redefining trust in global commerce by modernizing how cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits are done. We build software that empowers the practitioners who enable trust between businesses—automating and streamlining their work to deliver faster, higher-quality results. 
 We’re a remote-first company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, backed by top investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Y Combinator, Floodgate, Elad Gil, and more. Our team values diversity of backgrounds and experiences, and we’re deliberate about building an inclusive, humble, and high-performing culture. 
 
 About the Role 
 We’re hiring Software Engineers across multiple levels to join our growing team. Depending on your experience and interests, you may contribute as a mid-level engineer, take on leadership within a team, or drive technical strategy across teams and systems. The final level will be determined during the interview process based on scope and demonstrated experience. 
 This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company with clear product-market fit and massive growth potential. We’re taking on legacy audit and accounting tools that are decades old, widely disliked, and ripe for disruption. 
 Our engineering hub is located in San Francisco. This role is open to remote candidates anywhere in the US; Bay Area-based employees will work in a hybrid setting. 
 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 
 Design, build, and deliver high-quality features that drive customer and business impact 
 
 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design to turn complex problems into elegant, user-focused solutions 
 
 
 Balance iteration speed with long-term maintainability and system health 
 
 
 Continuously improve our tech stack, developer workflows, and reliability practices 
 
 
 Contribute to a supportive, growth-oriented engineering culture based on trust, learning, and excellence 
 
 
 Core Competencies (All Levels) 
 Technical Craft 
 
 
 Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping production code 
 
 
 Familiarity with modern web technologies such as TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, and GraphQL 
 
 
 Writing maintainable, well-tested, and observable code 
 
 
 Sound judgment around tradeoffs, reliability, and performance 
 
 
 Impact & Execution 
 
 
 Ability to scope, prioritize, and deliver work that moves business outcomes 
 
 
 Clear and proactive communication around progress, risks, and decisions 
 
 
 Ownership mindset - following work through from ideation to production and iteration 
 
 
 Collaboration & Influence 
 
 
 Empathy for teammates and customers; contributes positively to team culture 
 
 
 Open to feedback and committed to continuous improvement 
 
 
 Works effectively across disciplines and functions to achieve shared goals 
 
 
 Culture & Growth 
 
 
 Embodies Fieldguide’s values: Fearless, Fast, Lovable, Owners, Win-win, Inclusive 
 
 
 Mentors and supports peers; contributes to hiring and onboarding processes 
 
 
 Curious and self-driven in learning new skills, technologies, and domains 
 
 
 Take increasing ownership - from building features to shaping architecture and mentoring others - as you grow. 
 
 
 Higher-Level Responsibilities 
 At the Senior level, you may: 
 
 
 Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health 
 
 
 Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs 
 
 
 Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., frontend architecture, backend systems, developer experience) 
 
 
 Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team 
 
 
 At the Staff level, you may: 
 
 
 Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture 
 
 
 Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance

About Us 
 The financial advisory industry is a $80T market in the US, but has seen little technological innovation compared to the self-service market (Robinhood, Betterment, Wealthfront, SoFi). Client data management is a universally painful and expensive problem for financial advisors. Today, advisors manually collect, update, and utilize client data across the 7-10 software tools that they use to run their business. Data transcription and translation across systems is time-consuming and error-prone, leading to costly inefficiencies and embarrassing client-facing problems. Managing data access control, audit logs, and compliance is a constant challenge, particularly in larger organizations. 
 We are building the first wealth tech data orchestration company. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our  website . 
 
 Role Details 
 Role overview: 
 We're looking for a backend engineer to help build and scale our integration infrastructure. You'll work closely with our staff backend engineer to tackle complex problems in data mapping, syncing, and platform reliability while expanding our integration capabilities across the wealth tech ecosystem. 
 
 Where you'll make an impact: 
 
 
 Build and maintain integrations with third-party financial systems, expanding our platform's connectivity across the wealth tech landscape. 
 
 
 Solve complex data mapping and synchronization challenges, ensuring accurate and reliable data flow between disparate systems with different schemas and constraints. 
 
 
 Develop platform capabilities that enable seamless, scalable data orchestration for our customers' tech stacks. 
 
 
 Own end-to-end delivery of backend features and services, from design through deployment and monitoring. 
 
 
 Contribute to our integration infrastructure, building reusable patterns and tooling that make adding new integrations faster and more reliable. 
 
 
 Collaborate with frontend, product, and design teams to deliver high-quality customer experiences backed by robust backend systems. 
 
 
 Requirements: 
 
 
 4-6 years of backend engineering experience with a track record of shipping reliable, well-tested systems. 
 
 
 Strong fundamentals in backend development, including API design, data modeling, concurrent systems, and performance optimization. 
 
 
 Experience working with relational databases and distributed systems concepts. 
 
 
 Curious and eager to learn - you're excited to dig into unfamiliar systems, understand complex integrations, and grow your technical skills. 
 
 
 Bias toward action and ownership - you see a problem, propose solutions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction. 
 
 
 Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineers. 
 
 
 Thrive in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and high autonomy. 
 
 
 Interest and experience with AI tools and prompting - you leverage AI in your workflow and can help level up the team's capabilities. 
 
 
 You'll stand out if you have: 
 
 
 Experience building integrations, ETL pipelines, or working with third-party APIs at scale. 
 
 
 Exposure to financial services, fintech, or B2B SaaS products. 
 
 
 Experience at seed/early-stage startups where you wore multiple hats and moved quickly. 
 
 
 Familiarity with event-driven architectures, message queues, or data synchronization patterns. 
 
 
 Previously built side projects or contributed to open source software. 
 
 
 Our tech stack:  Golang, Redis, PostgreSQL, AWS SQS, Amazon S3
